newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania grain crop down to 14.2 mln T in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Romania grain crop down to 14.2 mln T in 1996.

text.p: Romania's grain output sagged to 14.2 million tonnes last year, a 5.7 million tonne drop from its bumper 1995 harvest, mainly due to adverse weather, a report by the National Statistics Board showed.
"Unfavourable weather in the spring of last year jeopardised extensive areas sown in the autumn of 1995, diminishing per-hectare average yields," the report said.

It said 1996 wheat and rye output had dropped to around 3.2 million tonnes, less than half the previous year's level, while the barley and two-row barley harvest was 709,000 tonnes down at 1.1 million tonnes.
Bad weather also affected the maize crop last year when it fell by 315,000 tonnes to 9.6 million tonnes.
But last year's maize output is seen as enough to meet consumption requirements and demand for fodder and Romania hopes to export some of the 1996 maize this year.
The report said output had risen last year in areas such as sunflower, soybeans, sugar beet and potatoes.

The sunflower crop was up by 163,000 tonnes to 1.09 million tonnes, soybeans output rose by around 5,000 tonnes to 113,000 tonnes and the sugar beet harvest was 194,000 tonnes up at 2.8 million tonnes.
The report said the private sector accounted for 83.2 percent of Romania's 1996 grain crop, 68.9 percent of the sunflower output and 80.6 percent of the sugar beet harvest.
It also accounted for 95.5 percent of potato output, the report said. -- Luli Popescu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
